text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, in the raffle... winning a 'Hot 
Springs Trip Voucher'."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Your answer from back then... Could I... 
hear it now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When was now, and is now when? I forgot 
long ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One thing is certain... Still in Love is 
right here.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The bus will be here shortly. Please wait 
just a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. What kind of dream was it?
choice_data_list: That was... back when I first met you...
That was... back when I first met you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How was I in your dream?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In a haze of clouded consciousness, 
memories intertwine. Yet no matter which 
moment I recall... it was shocking, 
thrilling... and my heart was filled with 
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However... there's just one thing—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even from now on... I'll keep entering 
races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if, back then... Looking back, it was 
probably the moment she decided not to 
hold back her instincts, to unleash 
everything and keep running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I had chosen a different path—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hey... darling. Hey...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm okay. Have a good, restful 
sleep..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's right here, Trainer. ...We've 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please take your time and take good care 
of yourself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, I was in the room. 
Still in Love stood there in her yukata...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...It was a long journey, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I'll open the window now. The stars are 
beautiful tonight...—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Here... How is it?
choice_data_list: It's all hazy... I can't see clearly...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...! ...It's beautiful. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the gaze you give me whenever 
you watch me run..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: What kind of race... should we enter next?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
Still in Love will... be loved even 
more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to weave her trajectory further and 
further. I want to make her name known 
more and more. And then—
choice_data_list:
I want to run to the ends of the earth... 
with you...

I want to run with you... to the ends of 
the earth...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san. I'd like to hear the 
rest of what you were asking earlier.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What about... me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: All this time... I've been so, so happy.
I've always... always been so happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Let me dry your hair.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please, this way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The slumber deepens once more. The 
boundary grows blurred...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment. I felt something cold on 
my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...I'm sorry. My hair... isn't 
properly dry yet.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was so... so very happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: And so—into the future as well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whatever form it may take, I will 
always... be by your side.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm happy. Truly... —So happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Still in Love 
and myself...
